# Paperless Accounting Bridge (PAB)

## Project

Professional document management application built around Paperless-ngx.

## Stack

- Python 3.12
- Django 5
- PostgreSQL 16
- Docker Compose
- Bootstrap 5

## Rules

- Use Django best practices.
- Use class-based views whenever appropriate.
- Use Django ORM only.
- Never access the Paperless database directly.
- Communicate with Paperless only through its REST API.
- Write clean, documented and typed Python code.
- Follow PEP8.
- Use English for source code.
- Use French for the user interface.
- Keep business logic inside dedicated services.
- Avoid duplicated code.

## Applications

- accounts
- companies
- core
- dashboard
- documents
- imports

## Database

PostgreSQL

## Authentication

Django authentication system.

## Frontend

Bootstrap 5

## Goal

Build a production-ready application.
